questions.question: What is resonance? Draw resonance structures of ozone and benzene.
questions.solution:
**Resonance:** When a single Lewis structure cannot describe a molecule, multiple structures (resonance contributors) are needed.

**Ozone (O₃):** O=O-O ↔ O-O=O (two equivalent structures)
**Benzene (C₆H₆):** Two Kekulé structures with alternating double bonds — actual structure is a resonance hybrid with equal C-C bond lengths.
questions.knowledgeNote: Resonance stabilization energy of benzene ≈ 152 kJ/mol — explains its unusual stability.
